errors.text_span: Die Linie für Deutschland (blaue durchgezogene Linie) beginnt bei etwa 55 % im Jahr 1995, bleibt bis 2005 relativ stabil bei etwa 60 %, steigt dann stark an und erreicht 2021 etwa 205 %, bevor sie ab 2023 wieder auf etwa 150 % sinkt.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly attributes the data trend of Greece (Griechenland) to Germany (Deutschland). The German line never exceeds 85%, while the Greek line peaks above 200%.
The description completely omits the data series for Greece (Griechenland), which is one of the eight countries shown in the plot and exhibits the most dramatic trend (peaking above 200%).
The line for the Eurozone is at approximately 70% in 2005, not 65%. It reaches its minimum of about 68% in 2007.
The line for France reaches approximately 115% in 2021, not 100%.
The line for the Eurozone is not stable after 2010; it rises to a peak around 2014 and then declines.

errors.text_span: bleibt danach relativ stabil bei etwa 100 % bis 2025
errors.evidence: The description for Belgium over-generalizes the trend after 2005. The line dips to a low of about 85% in 2007 before rising again to over 100%, which is not 'relatively stable at 100%'.
The line for Spain falls to approximately 43% by 2005, not 50%. It continues to fall to a minimum of about 35% in 2007.

errors.text_span: bevor sie ab 2023 wieder auf etwa 100 % sinkt
errors.evidence: The line for Spain is at approximately 108% in 2025, it does not sink to 100%.

errors.text_span: bevor sie ab 2023 wieder auf etwa 100 % sinkt
errors.evidence: The line for France remains around 110-112% after 2023; it does not sink to 100%.
